name: Personal Kanban Visual Pull Buffer
diagnostic: Push-system overload. Downstream execution bottlenecks become overwhelmed when tasks are scheduled directly into calendars rather than pulled into execution capacity.

procedure.text: Put a Ready to Pull buffer immediately before the In-Flight column.
Fill it only during triage, with tasks that are refined, unblocked and self-contained.
Cap the buffer at five items, one day's realistic execution.
Pull from it only when an active WIP slot frees up.

trap: Letting vague, unrefined tasks into the pull buffer. A task that needs outside input stalls execution and locks up a WIP slot.
procedureFull:
1. Insert a discrete Ready to Pull staging buffer immediately before the In-Flight execution column.
2. Populate this buffer exclusively during daily or weekly triage with fully refined, non-blocked, self-contained tasks.
3. Limit the buffer size to 5 items to match single-day execution potential.
4. The operator only pulls from Ready to Pull when their active WIP slot falls below the hard limit.
setupFull:
| Ready to Pull (Cap: 5) | Active Execution (Cap: 1) | Completed Today |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| [ ] Unit test AuthToken validation | [ ] Refactor SQL connection pool | [x] Deploy v1.4.2 patch |
| [ ] Document internal REST routes |  | [x] Review PR #481 |
| [ ] Fix Redis heartbeat failure |  |  |
trapFull: Allowing unclarified, ambiguous items into the pull buffer. A task pulled into execution that requires unresolved external inputs stalls the system, locking up active WIP capacity.
